aero_engineer.text: That's Alpha Foxtrot, the last Concorde ever to fly. She landed at Filton in 2003, right where she was built.
Concorde cruised at Mach 2, twice the speed of sound. The skin got so hot the plane stretched by about 20 centimetres in flight.
Bristol's built aircraft since 1910, when the Bristol Boxkite first flew. Biplanes, airliners, Concorde. Wings still get made round here.

then.text: Burner valve all right? Tell Gwen she owes me a flight. A slow one.

else.text: A burner valve for Gwen's balloon? We've built wings for jumbo jets here. I think we can manage a valve.
Propane burns at about 2,000 degrees. Heats the air inside the envelope to about 100. Mind your eyebrows.
